description:
In this compelling episode of Bible Q&A, our panel tackles tough, real-life questions from viewers around the world. From spiritual deception and the state of the dead to the challenges of marriage, forgiveness, and mental health—no topic is off limits. What happens when a Christian remarries after the death of a spouse? Can someone go to heaven if they’ve never led a soul to Christ? How do we explain deathbed visions, Sabbath work obligations, or the emotional weight of feeling spiritually isolated? Join us for this thought-provoking discussion rooted in Scripture and filled with practical, hope-filled answers.


Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
By text: (618) 228-3975

QUESTIONS COVERED:

1.  I've heard some testimonies of people being taken captive spiritually by demons due to witchcraft. Some had even attended their funerals and saw their bodies being buried. How can these testimonies be explained in comparison with the state of the dead? Can you please explain the state of the dead?

2. A Christian widow of a spouse, who died in Christ, remarries another person who later dies in the Lord. When they all reconnect in heaven, which marriage is honored? When Christian widows remarry, which marriage will be honored in Heaven?

3. I understand that in heaven the stars on the crowns, of redeemed from the earth, represent the souls each person has won. It is said that there will be no starless crown. My question is, will a person who has not led any souls to Christ have a place in Heaven?

4.  My wife & I have been married for more than 20 years. We have a mentally challenged son. Every time we get into a topic she's not comfortable with, she starts blaming me and my family for our son's inherited mentally disabled condition. I really feel terrible that my wife sees me and my family as carriers of these mental health conditions. How do I navigate constant blame from my wife?  

5. It's a well noted phenomena that happens with people at the edge of death. Hospice calls it visioning, where the person sees &/or hears loved ones that have passed on? I have a hard time believing that these are demonic visions. How does the Bible explain this end of life event? Does the Bible mention anything about end of life events?

6.  If a person steals or robs someone purposely guided by vindictiveness; will they be held accountable for their actions? They claim that they are a born again Christian. Will a person who steals be held accountable for their actions?

7.  I've studied the 28 fundamentals, of course. I've agreed with them all except for the one about jewelry. There is only one scripture that cautions against wearing jewelry and it more so instructs us to focus on our inner man than our outer appearance, 1 Timothy 2 :9-10. It doesn't forbid wearing jewelry. Why is not wearing jewelry a fundamental belief? 

8. Can you explain Judges 11:34-35? I find it almost inconceivable that a human sacrifice was condoned. I read of animal sacrifices in the Bible but never human sacrifices. 

9. I would like to know how to have true peace when others around me do not want to go into the truth? My husband, neighbors, and friends are not interested in the truth. I wholeheartedly send them invites to church or tell them about church events, but they disregard. I need peace because this hurts me and I stress about it. How can I have true peace when trying to lead others to the truth?

10.  How do I forgive others? 

11. People always say that Cain was the first murderer. But realistically, wasn't Adam the first murderer? His disobedience plunged our whole human race into sin subject to death. Is my reasoning wrong? Who murdered first, Cain or Adam?

12. According to Exodus 20:8, Jesus said, “Remember the Sabbath day and keep it holy.” As a Christian, will I not make it to heaven because my job requires me to work every other day Saturday? Will I make it to Heaven if I have to work on Sabbath?
